cells.gaps: The 81.8% is the BCEAO-style overall rate of use of financial services and is not attributed to a survey. No survey found since November 2023 puts adults who made or received a digital payment at 79% or more.
cells.note: The national financial inclusion agency puts the overall rate of use of financial services at 81.8% at the end of 2025, four in five or more; not attributed to a survey, staged on it as the ladder is read now, as Senegal's BCEAO rate is. No survey gives the share paying digitally.
